text: $p>-3,~q>\frac{1}{2}$$y=4\left( x-3\right) ^{2}+1$에서 주어진 조건만큼 평행이동 시킨 식은$y=4\left( x-3-p\right) ^{2}+1-2q$이므로꼭짓점의 좌표는 $(3+p,~1-2q)$이고 제$4$사분면은 $x$의 좌표는 양수, $y$의 좌표는 음수이므로$3+p>0,~p>-3$$1-2q<0,~q>\frac{1}{2}$$\therefore ~p>-3,~q>\frac{1}{2}$

$31.3m$풍선이 있는 쪽의 꼭짓점을 $\mathrm{C}$라고 하면$\angle \mathrm{ACH}=36\,°,~\angle \mathrm{BCH}=40\,°$이므로$\tan \,36°=\frac{\overline{AH}}{20}=0.7265$$\tan \,40°=\frac{\overline{BH}}{20}=0.8391$이므로$\overline{AH}=20\times 0.7265=14.53$$\overline{BH}=20\times 0.8391=16.782$$\overline{AB}=\overline{AH}+\overline{HB}=14.53+16.782=31.312$소수점 아래 둘째 자리에서 반올림을 하면 $31.3\,\mathrm{m}$

$27+9\sqrt{3}$$\mathrm{\overset{\frown}{AB}:\,\overset{\frown}{BC}:\,\overset{\frown}{CA}=4:\,3:\,5}$이므로$\angle AOB:\angle BOC:\angle COA=4:3:5$$\angle AOB=360\,°\times \frac{4}{4+3+5}=120\,°$$\angle BOC=360\,°\times \frac{3}{4+3+5}=90\,°$$\angle COA=360\,°\times \frac{5}{4+3+5}=150\,°$$\triangle AOB=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 6\times \sin \,120°=18\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=9\sqrt{3}$$\triangle BOC=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 6\times \sin \,90°=18\times 1=18$$\triangle COA=\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 6\times \sin \,150°=18\times \frac{1}{2}=9$$\triangle ABC=\triangle AOB+\triangle BOC+\triangle COA$ 이므로$\therefore ~\triangle ABC=27+9\sqrt{3}$
